name: Object-space decomposition with local clustering
definition: The k-way partitioning performed in each processor Pk effectively constitutes a K-way global clustering solution C = [C1, C2, ..., CK].
summary: Object-space decomposition with local clustering partitions unstructured volumes into topologically connected clusters via graph partitioning, distinguished by its view-independent preprocessing that enables rapid, view-dependent remapping without re-partitioning geometry.
